## Checklist

See CONTRIBUTING.md for each rule.

- [ ] Every source is my own work or its terms allow copying in and releasing under MIT (CC0, public domain).
- [ ] Every source has its row in `config/sources.toml`, quoting its terms and the date I read them.
- [ ] No personal data, no recognisable person without written consent, no logos or trademarks.
- [ ] Nothing from a paid store or pack whose licence forbids redistribution; no mock or placeholder files.
- [ ] Added with `score-lib take-in` (or the kind's own command); entries are drafts and no locked entry is changed.
- [ ] `score-lib verify --address <address>` prints no failure and `uv run pytest` passes.
- [ ] Quality score: ___ (a reason given if under 50).
- [ ] Models, kits, characters: in metres, Y up, real size; pass SCORE's USD check and library check in a place.
- [ ] No bytes in git; the blobs are uploaded to the Hugging Face dataset: <link>
- [ ] I release this contribution under the MIT licence in `LICENSE`.
